messages.author: 5c6e92c10ef28984
messages.subject: Re: Problem with annotation and fractionation
parts:
Hi,


it's a generic message, doesn't mean there are fractions. If there was no "Fractions" column in the input and now it's a constant column, means the converter just added it.

Please check if the set of values for run ID is the same in the annotation and your input. Common problem is that there are file extensions in one, but not the other.

Kind regards,
Mateusz
